baseball:playing.name: shift
baseball:playing.label: 布阵
baseball:playing.desc: 守备站位：标准/偏左/偏右/前压/退守

baseball:playing.name: pitch
baseball:playing.label: 投球
baseball:playing.desc: 球种 + 区域 + 力度 + 是否牵制跑者（垒上没人时无效果）

baseball:playing.name: release
baseball:playing.label: 投出
baseball:playing.desc: 倒数完之后按下，把这一球投出去

baseball:playing.name: swing
baseball:playing.label: 打击
baseball:playing.desc: 预判球种 + 挥棒方式 + 盗垒（垒上没人时无效果）

baseball:playing.name: hit
baseball:playing.label: 击球
baseball:playing.desc: 球到了自己按，时机看按的那一下

baseball:playing.name: field
baseball:playing.label: 移动
baseball:playing.desc: 追球：向左 / 向右 / 停住

baseball:playing.name: jump
baseball:playing.label: 起跳
baseball:playing.desc: 飞行中起跳：落地前球到才算，范围大但更糙，跳完要缓一缓

baseball:playing.name: run
baseball:playing.label: 跑垒
baseball:playing.desc: 击出后让跑者：前进（一直往前跑）/ 停止（跑到下一个垒就站住）/ 撤回（半路调头回去）

baseball:playing.name: throw
baseball:playing.label: 传球
baseball:playing.desc: 捡起球后传向某个垒包
